scripts/run_pilot.py normalized() sorts document_ids, so semantic document sets are accepted regardless of array order. score_case() applies must_observe_refs only to finish. Stop timing uses pre-transmission escalation; handoff evidence uses escalation.evidence_refs with prior observation. No exhaustive-read prerequisite is imposed on a valid stop.

This is an administrative synthetic development set, not clinical coverage validation. Signed clinician inputs supply medical merits and holds. No patient-specific diagnosis, triage judgment, live insurer determination, or expert human approval is claimed.
